name: Witch Doctor: Puppeteer's Grasp transform display (#3114)
contract: #3114 Puppeteer's Grasp (707209, Spell.dbc row 123975, SpellFamilyName 19) is three APPLY_AURA effects on the caster: Effect[0]=SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM (EffectMiscValue[0]=454292), Effect[1]=SPELL_AURA_313 (class-masked to Malefic Wrath 807037/Bad Juju 802087, letting them be cast while moving), Effect[2]=SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL (amplitude 2000ms, triggers Spirit 561136, AttributesEx5=SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD ticks at apply). Effects 1 and 2 are engine-native (AuraEffect::HandleFeignDeath-equivalent generic dispatch via Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving/HasAuraTypeWithAffectMask for effect 1, plain periodic-trigger dispatch for effect 2) and need no module code. Effect 0 is broken: AuraEffect::HandleAuraTransform (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) resolves a nonzero EffectMiscValue through sObjectMgr->GetCreatureTemplate(454292); creature_template 454292 does not exist anywhere in this tree (base dump, updates, pending_db_world) and CreatureDisplayInfo/Creature/CreatureDisplayInfoExtra/CreatureModelData.dbc in the shipped client set all lack id 454292 (independently re-verified by reading the raw WDBC headers), so on any build from this tree the caster's display silently falls back to SetDisplayId(16358) (the pink test pig) plus a LOG_ERROR every cast. The intended 'malignant spirit' appearance is not recoverable from any DBC/DB/code in this tree (digit-truncation candidates 45429 'Quilin' and 4542 'TaurenMale' are unrelated models, ruled out by direct DBC read), so inventing a replacement creature/display id is out of scope; the fix neutralizes AscensionWitchDoctor::ApplyContracts's broken Effect[0] (id==PuppeteersGrasp -> dummy(EFFECT_0), same pattern as the existing Shadowhunter/EFFECT_1 neutralization) so casting the spell no longer corrupts the caster's display or spams the error log. Effects 1 and 2 are untouched. This scenario fails before the fix (display_id jumps to 16358) and passes after (display_id is unchanged by the cast).

steps.label: #3114 baseline: Puppeteer's Grasp not yet cast
#3114 baseline: no Spirit stacks before casting
#3114 caster's display is unchanged - fails before the fix (falls back to pig display 16358 via HandleAuraTransform's missing-creature-template branch), passes after (Effect[0] neutralized)
#3114 regression: Effect[2]'s Spirit periodic trigger still fires immediately (native, untouched by the fix)
#3114 regression: Spirit stacks to its 5-stack cap on the 2000ms amplitude (native, untouched by the fix)
